history.titleZh: 对数据中心的抵制正在团结美国
history.descriptionZh:
2026年美国选举中，数据中心正成为罕见的跨党派动员议题。大型服务器存储设施快速扩张，连同配套基础设施建设和成本，已在全美多地引发社区反对，并进入国会和州长选战的核心议程。与此同时，科技资本大量涌入相关选战：由风险投资人马克·安德森和OpenAI总裁格雷格·布罗克曼支持的超级政治行动委员会“Leading the Future”一年内已支出4500万美元；自称支持AI保障措施的Anthropic支持团体“Public First Action”称已筹集8000万美元，两者均资助了民主党和共和党相关团体。新成立的“Tomorrow Together”则投入400万美元，在众议院关键选区投放有关数据中心开发和AI安全的广告。各类候选人普遍试图与数据中心保持距离，以回应选民对“后院无序扩张”的担忧，但在是否支持暂停开发甚至全面禁令上立场不一。

本文并非某项芯片或算法技术发布，因此不涉及具体技术原理创新；其核心是AI数据中心作为算力基础设施的外部性治理：大规模建设带来电力、水资源、并网和税收补贴压力，也牵动地方控制、国家安全和儿童安全等政治议题。各州选情如下：

得克萨斯州：得州计划中的数据中心项目数量仅次于弗吉尼亚州，数据中心已成为州长和参议院选战的关键楔子议题。民主党参议员候选人、州众议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科提出“追究数据中心责任计划”，主张取消州销售税优惠、让社区在数据中心开发中拥有更多发言权、要求新建数据中心采用闭环水系统以减少耗水，并建立保护电网和环境的联邦标准；他还提议对“可归因于AI的利润”征税，向美国人发放“AI红利”。共和党参议员候选人、得州总检察长肯·帕克斯顿提出“得州优先数据中心计划”，支持州长格雷格·阿博特的州级政策，包括废除数据中心销售税豁免、要求其支付所用电费并增加州电力容量、阻止AI数据中心在得州农村地区建设；在联邦层面，他表示将共同发起便于数据中心接入离网电力系统的现有法案，提出禁止中国技术用于美国数据中心或基础设施的新立法，并让数据中心企业对“助长危害儿童安全的AI聊天机器人”承担刑事责任。州长选战中，民主党挑战者、州众议员吉娜·希诺霍萨指责阿博特在数据中心问题上“ flip-flop”：阿博特办公室去年曾庆祝谷歌400亿美元投资、包括三个新数据中心园区，但2026年8月竞选升温时宣布审计，可能减缓新设施接入州电网。希诺霍萨呼吁全州暂停数据中心开发，并在社交媒体视频中称阿博特“毫无可信度”。库克政治报告本月将州长选情从“可能共和党胜”调整为“倾向共和党”，参议院开放席位选情则为“胜负难料”。

佛罗里达州：争论焦点是用政策约束大型数据中心，还是直接禁止。民主党州长候选人、前国会议员戴维·乔利承诺上任首日实施为期一年的超大规模数据中心禁令，且不排除永久延长；一则广告把数据中心与犯罪并列为他不想在佛州看到的事物。共和党对手、国会议员拜伦·唐纳兹此前支持该州数据中心开发，称佛州对建设“完全开放”但不应破坏美景；近期他改变语调，仍不支持全面禁令，但试图让选民相信他会保护其免受能源成本上升等风险。7月，唐纳兹提出《保护费率纳税人法案》，要求数据中心开发商为其运营所需能源和水付费，并支持一项有类似要求和环境护栏的州法。他在广告中称：“在我的佛州，如果你不保护我们的钱包和人民，就根本别建数据中心。”但能源专家警告，唐纳兹依赖核能和天然气的承诺可能反而推高消费者成本。尽管努力，他仍被对手称为“数据中心唐纳兹”。10月NBC6/Telemundo民调显示，45%可能选民反对佛州建设数据中心，38%支持，17%未决定；反对在自身社区建设者达59%。但唐纳兹仍以48%对41%领先乔利，误差±4个百分点，10%未决定。

宾夕法尼亚州：民主党州长乔什·夏皮罗和共和党挑战者、州财政部长斯泰西·加里蒂都因数据中心开发反弹而强化立场，并互相指责对方为选票改变措辞。夏皮罗去年高调宣布亚马逊200亿美元投资，将在宾州新建数据中心，并归功于该州快速审批计划；今年8月他签署行政令，禁止数据中心开发商签署保密协议，并将AI数据中心提案移出快速通道，称观点基于社区反馈演变。加里蒂去年在电台采访中称宾州农村地区是“建设数据中心的完美地点”，会因经济机会受到欢迎，并称赞亚马逊投资；今年她表示开发商必须与社区接触，不能“强塞”，并支持不超过三年的开发暂停。10月初昆尼皮亚克大学民调显示，64%可能选民认为宾州AI数据中心害大于利，误差±3.9个百分点；民主党受访者中80%持此看法，显示夏皮罗需巩固基本盘。但民调仍显示夏皮罗以59%对34%领先加里蒂。

俄亥俄州参议院：泄露的全国共和党参议院委员会备忘录称，数据中心既是“新 ingredient（也是新问题）”，并警告共和党现任参议员乔恩·赫斯特德与民主党候选人谢罗德·布朗“势均力敌”，数据中心是“挂在赫斯特德脖子上的锚”。布朗把反对数据中心作为竞选核心，称赫斯特德是该州“数据中心的面孔”，攻击其任副州长时支持税收优惠。赫斯特德认为应由当地社区决定是否引入数据中心，一些社区可能认为收入有用。至少截至8月，NRSC仍认为选民更支持地方决定而非全面禁令，但承认当前观感负面，并警告若赫斯特德败选且数据中心被归咎，全国政客将“避而远之”。赫斯特德提出《费率纳税人保护法案》，要求数据中心等大负荷客户承担自身能源成本及所需基础设施升级，众议院通过后在参议院以微弱差距失败，即使有少数民主党人支持。库克政治报告评为胜负难料，RealClear Polling近期民调均值显示布朗略领先。

密歇根州：两个关键选情差距极小，数据中心是热点。该州正处理数十个新数据中心提案。参议院开放席位中，共和党前众议员迈克·罗杰斯支持一年暂停但反对联邦禁令；民主党候选人、前公共卫生官员阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德主张“在能够安全建设并获得联邦保护之前不再建数据中心”。罗杰斯支持暂停是在The Lever报道其投资可能从建设中受益数天后。埃尔-赛义德较早将数据中心置于初选核心，Politico 2月称此类“黑马”候选人正以此为核心议题。库克政治报告称该选情胶着，可能决定国会力量平衡；两人争夺民主党人加里·彼得斯不再寻求连任的席位。众议院另一胶着选情中，民主党组织者威廉·劳伦斯挑战共和党现任议员汤姆·巴雷特。劳伦斯初选时呼吁联邦暂停新建数据中心一年，获胜时支持者高喊“数据中心输了”。巴雷特今夏提出两项法案，加强地方对数据中心开发的决策权，并禁止联邦议员签署数据中心保密协议；劳伦斯的计划包括环境标准、工人保护和数据中心开发“分区缓冲”。

威斯康星州州长：两名候选人都从此前支持数据中心后退，但均未呼吁暂停。民主党候选人、密尔沃基县行政长官戴维·克劳利与进步派初选对手弗朗西斯卡·洪拉开差距，未反对后者支持的开发暂停；共和党候选人、国会议员汤姆·蒂芙尼同样反对暂停、支持护栏，并投票支持加快数据中心项目审批的法案，但仍试图把对手称为“数据中心戴维·克劳利”，指其过去称州不应“自动取消所有数据中心税收优惠”。克劳利近期表示会签署废除数据中心税收补贴的法案。库克政治报告称选情胶着。

内华达州州长：内华达民主党创建网站，将共和党州长乔·隆巴多称为“数据中心乔”，突出其过去支持数据中心的言论及竞选接受AI相关捐款。隆巴多上个月发布行政令，将税收优惠与开发商承担电力成本、满足用水标准挂钩，并授权州政府追回违规资金。民主党挑战者、总检察长亚伦·福特表示会走得更远，完全暂停对新数据中心的税收优惠；但他因2015年支持确立数据中心税收优惠的法案而受批评，回应称“11年前的数据中心和2026年的数据中心不是一回事”。在水资源问题突出的内华达，该议题尤为敏感。库克政治报告称选情胜负难料。

佐治亚州州长：摇摆州佐治亚被称为“全国最具吸引力的AI、超大规模云和企业数据中心开发市场之一”。民主党候选人、前亚特兰大市长凯莎·兰斯·博特姆斯支持暂停开发以评估环境和成本影响；共和党候选人、医疗高管里克·杰克逊认为应由地方社区决定是否引入数据中心。最近辩论中，博特姆斯称对手因投资得州数据中心“不可信任”；杰克逊反击称博特姆斯任市长时批准并向多个数据中心提供税收优惠，博特姆斯否认，称只批准了一个非超大规模、且不在居民区附近的数据中心。《亚特兰大宪章报》报道，博特姆斯2018年领导Invest Atlanta董事会时，该组织批准了最多4.4亿美元债券用于佐治亚理工混合用途项目，其中包含数据中心；报道称这不是“直接融资机制”，但帮助项目获得税收减免，且该数据中心远小于当前主要争议项目。库克政治报告称选情胶着。

亚利桑那州州长和总检察长：在干旱的亚利桑那，水资源是许多选民首要议题，最有趣的冲突在党内而非党际。民主党州长凯蒂·霍布斯和总检察长克里斯·梅斯分别与共和党挑战者、国会议员安迪·比格斯和州议员沃伦·彼得森陷入激战，但两名民主党人在数据中心监管上分裂：梅斯支持全州暂停开发，霍布斯反对。梅斯称州应“缓一缓”评估水和能源需求；彼得森罕见直接为数据中心辩护，称“如果你喜欢科技、手机、电脑及其用途，你大概会认为数据中心重要”。霍布斯称数据中心不会消失，州应研究如何让其最好地服务社区，这使她更接近同样反对暂停的共和党对手。

爱荷华州州长：开放州长席位选情胶着，数据中心居中心。州经济发展局称爱荷华的风能、低建设和商业成本吸引开发商，但增长也引发社区担忧。民主党候选人、州审计员罗布·桑德不支持全面暂停，但表示将终止数据中心税收优惠、要求其承担自身成本，并防止保密协议向社区隐瞒交易；共和党候选人、商人扎克·拉恩呼吁暂停新开发并取消税收激励。

总体看，数据中心已从地方规划争议上升为2026年选举中的全国性政治议题：候选人竞相展示强硬立场，但在“地方控制、暂停开发、全面禁令、税收优惠和成本承担”之间分化明显。科技资本则同时资助两党相关团体，试图影响AI监管和数据中心政策走向。若数据中心成为关键选票议题，可能反过来改变美国AI算力基础设施的扩张节奏和监管环境。

history.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt financing for GPUs expected in the first half of 2027, Musk says
history.description: SpaceX expects fourth-quarter capital expenditure of $35 billion to $40 billion, CFO Bret Johnsen said, as Elon Musk pushes to expand the company’s AI computing infrastructure.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Elon Musk has confirmed that SpaceX closed $40 billion in debt financing for graphics processing units (GPUs), with the chips expected to arrive in the first half of 2027. He disclosed the deal on X, October 25 (embedded below) while responding to investor Chamath Palihapitiya, who had warned that mounting financing pressures and delays in data center construction could leave AI computing capacity sitting idle next year.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleMusk agreed with that assessment, but argued that SpaceX is better positioned than many of its competitors because it can borrow against revenue from businesses outside AI. “Pretty much,” Musk replied to Palihapitiya on X explaining that debt markets had largely shut off funding for companies without substantial revenue independent of AI data centers.He further said SpaceX had closed $40 billion in debt for GPUs because it has investment-grade status and revenue from its Starlink satellite internet and space businesses. “That means the 200+ neoclouds are going to see guppy-level death and consolidation. Some will make it through, but not many,” Musk wrote.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Pretty much. As of the past few weeks, debt markets have almost entirely shut off access to money for any company that doesn’t have substantial revenue independent of AI data centers. SpaceX closed $40B of debt for GPUs, but we’re investment grade and have Starlink & launch revenue. That means the 200+ neoclouds are going to see guppy-level death and consolidation. Some will make it through, but not many.October 25, 2026It is still, however, unclear what Musk meant by “closed” or whether investors had agreed to the final debt pricing. The disclosure comes as SpaceX prepares for another enormous spending period. CFO Bret Johnsen had stated during SpaceX’s Q3 2026 earnings call that the company expects capital expenditure of $35 billion to $40 billion in Q4 “because of the additional capacity coming online this quarter.”Musk also clarified that the borrowing was primarily callable debt for GPU purchases expected to arrive in the first and second quarters of 2027. “This is primarily callable debt for GPU purchases that will arrive in Q1 and Q2. Not a major factor this quarter,” Musk wrote. You may like SpaceX reportedly seeking $40 billion debt package for Nvidia AI hardware Elon Musk says xAI will increase data center capacity 7x by 2027 Elon Musk's SpaceXAI to add another 660,000 AI GPUs this year, nearing a total of 1.44 million in operation Earlier this month, it emerged SpaceX had proposed a $40 billion debt package for Nvidia hardware, estimating that the proposed funding could cover roughly 360,000 Rubin GPUs across 5,000 Nvidia NVL72 racks. The proposed package reportedly included $10 billion in bank loans and $30 billion in investment-grade debt. Musk has now said the financing has closed, but has not confirmed the specific GPU models or quantities covered by the deal.The spending fits into Musk’s broader push to expand AI computing capacity. In August, xAI outlined plans to increase its data center capacity sevenfold by 2027, targeting 10 gigawatts. In September, the publication also reported that SpaceXAI planned to add another 660,000 Nvidia GPUs during 2026, potentially bringing its total to around 1.44 million if the planned deployments proceed.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsAnd GPUs are only part of the bill. Data centers need power, cooling, networking equipment, and physical infrastructure before those accelerators can do useful work, which underscores SpaceX’s latest move.SpaceX, meanwhile, has begun selling access to its own infrastructure. In May, Anthropic secured access to SpaceX’s Colossus 1 supercomputer, which includes more than 220,000 Nvidia GPUs and over 300 megawatts of computing capacity. Later in June, SpaceX struck a separate deal with Google, which agreed to pay $920 million per month for access to approximately 110,000 Nvidia GPUs and related hardware, with payments scheduled to run from October 2026 through June 2029. history.titleZh: 马斯克称SpaceX完成400亿美元债务融资，用于预计2027年上半年交付的GPU
history.descriptionZh:
埃隆·马斯克2026年10月25日在X上回复投资人Chamath Palihapitiya时确认，SpaceX已完成400亿美元债务融资，用于采购GPU，相关芯片预计在2027年上半年到货。此举的背景是，Palihapitiya警告融资压力上升和数据中心建设延迟，可能导致明年AI计算能力闲置。马斯克大体认同这一判断，但强调SpaceX因具备投资级信用，并有Starlink卫星互联网和航天发射业务收入，可以依托非AI业务现金流举债；他称过去几周债务市场几乎已对没有AI数据中心之外实质收入的公司关闭融资大门。马斯克还预计，200多家“neocloud”新兴GPU云厂商将经历残酷出清和整合，只有少数能够存活。不过，外界仍不清楚他所说的“closed”具体含义，也不确定最终债务定价是否已经敲定。

交易结构上，本月初有报道称，SpaceX拟为英伟达硬件安排400亿美元债务包，其中包括100亿美元银行贷款和300亿美元投资级债务，预计可覆盖约36万颗Rubin GPU，部署在5000个英伟达NVL72机架中。NVL72是机架级AI系统，集成72颗GPU并通过高速NVLink互联，面向大规模AI训练和推理；Rubin则是英伟达下一代GPU架构。按5000个机架、每机架72颗GPU计算，正好对应36万颗GPU。马斯克此次只确认融资关闭、GPU将在2027年第一季度和第二季度到货，并未确认具体GPU型号和数量，并称这主要是可赎回债务，对本季度影响不大。

资金安排还与SpaceX更大规模的算力扩张相衔接。SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen在2026年第三季度财报电话会上表示，公司预计第四季度资本开支为350亿至400亿美元，原因是新增产能将上线。2026年8月，xAI提出到2027年将数据中心容量扩大7倍，目标达到10吉瓦；9月又有报道称，SpaceXAI计划在2026年新增66万颗英伟达GPU，若部署按计划推进，总量可能达到约144万颗。GPU只是整体账单的一部分，数据中心还需要电力、冷却、网络设备和物理基础设施，才能让加速器真正投入有效工作，这也凸显此次融资是AI算力基础设施军备竞赛的一环。

应用层面，SpaceX已开始对外出售基础设施访问权。2026年5月，Anthropic获得SpaceX Colossus 1超算访问权，该系统包含超过22万颗英伟达GPU和超过300兆瓦计算容量；6月，SpaceX又与Google达成协议，Google同意每月支付9.2亿美元，访问约11万颗英伟达GPU及相关硬件，付款期从2026年10月持续到2029年6月。分析认为，在债务市场收紧、数据中心建设延迟风险上升的背景下，拥有投资级评级和非AI收入的巨头更有能力锁定GPU、电力和基础设施，而依赖单一AI收入的中小新云厂商将面临整合压力。此次GPU融资也表明，AI竞争正从芯片采购延伸到资本结构、能源保障和数据中心交付能力。

history.content: Less than a month after its mass release of hundreds of manuscripts that it said contained solutions to long-standing mathematics questions, OpenAI is back with three more “major” discoveries in math, computer science, and physics. What’s different this time is the choice to have external experts that OpenAI describes as “shepherds” guiding the results in computer science and physics, while for the math problem it says that they advised it to release the AI output for researchers to work through their own explanations.OpenAI results added to GitHub today:Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation. The proof uses an auxiliary partial differential equation to establish Sogge’s local smoothing for waves in every spatial dimension at least two. It also yields the Kakeya maximal and dimension conjectures and Stein’s spherical restriction estimates throughout the interior of the conjectured range. We are releasing the model output directly, as we did in our October 6 release.The Exponential Time Hypothesis is False. The paper gives a deterministic algorithm that exactly counts satisfying assignments of fixed-width CNF formulas in subexponential time and polynomial space. The case of 3-SAT refutes the Exponential Time Hypothesis. An independent working group of computer scientists led by Russell Impagliazzo, Ramamohan Paturi, and Ryan Williams will examine and explain the proof. At the group’s request, we are making the materials public immediately so others can examine them as well.This approach could have its own issues, the company admits, and the AGMAI panel of math advisers OpenAI put together just said yesterday that “we recommend that AI companies do not adopt” the practices of designating certain people to receive the output first, citing unequal access, borrowed reputation, and biased selection as a few of the issues. Instead, they recommended that in the future, AI labs release output on scholarly repositories, with Lean-formalized proofs, info on how the problems were chosen, funding for people working on understanding the results, and other information.Related‘Pure insanity’: Mathematicians will need years to make sense of OpenAI’s latest dropAll the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematicsThe physics information has not been released in full, but is a “mathematically rigorous existence proof of certain interacting quantum field theories containing gauge fields and fermions in four dimensions, including Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD) and a unified completion of the Standard Model of particle physics.” According to OpenAI, “David Gross will lead a group including Michael Douglas, Arthur Jaffe, Igor Klebanov, and Nikita Nekrasov that will shepherd this work.”The computer science collaboration is said to prove that the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), which has been widely believed to be true, is actually false. OpenAI says verification of the result will be guided by a group of three experts that includes UC San Diego’s Russell Impagliazzo and Ramamohan Paturi, who were part of the group that originally proposed it in 1999, as well as MIT professor Ryan Williams. The group decided to release the AI output write-up and Lean proof on GitHub today.They also released an open letter to the community asking for input on how to examine the claim, and about setting norms for dealing with AI-generated breakthroughs:We would welcome discussion of three broader questions:What expectations should govern early access to AI-generated results, disclosure of conflicts of interest, and the use of unpublished material for subsequent research?How should credit recognize both new discoveries and the work of checking, fixing, simplifying, explaining, and extending them?How can we support students and researchers as methods and research directions change, while preserving the understanding and judgment needed to question results and develop new ideas?There’s similar documentation for the math breakthrough, where its model “produced a proof of the local smoothing conjecture in every dimension and therefore also resolve the Kakeya conjecture and Stein’s restriction conjecture in all dimensions.” Just a few months ago, NYU professor Hong Wang was awarded a prestigious Fields Medal by the International Mathematical Union for resolving the Kakeya conjecture in three dimensions.

history.titleZh: OpenAI宣布三项重大科学发现以及与学术界合作的新方式
history.descriptionZh:
OpenAI在不到一个月前声称发布数百篇手稿、包含长期数学难题解决方案后，又公布了数学、计算机科学和物理学三项“重大”发现。此次的不同在于：计算机科学和物理学结果由OpenAI称为“shepherd”的外部专家小组引导验证；数学问题则据称由顾问建议直接发布AI输出，让研究人员自行推导解释。OpenAI今天将相关材料加入GitHub。

数学方面，结果为“欧几里得波方程的局部平滑”。证明使用一个辅助偏微分方程，在空间维度至少为2的所有情形下建立Sogge的波局部平滑；还推出Kakeya极大猜想和维数猜想，以及在猜想范围内所有内部区域的Stein球面限制估计。OpenAI表示，与10月6日发布一样，直接公开模型输出。与此相关，几个月前纽约大学Hong Wang因解决三维Kakeya猜想获国际数学联盟菲尔兹奖；而此次OpenAI称其模型给出所有维度局部平滑猜想的证明，并因此解决所有维度的Kakeya猜想和Stein限制猜想。

计算机科学方面，题为“指数时间假设为假”。论文给出一个确定性算法，可在次指数时间和多项式空间中精确计数固定宽度CNF公式的满足赋值；3-SAT情形即可反驳指数时间假设（ETH）。ETH自1999年提出后广被相信。OpenAI称，由Russell Impagliazzo、Ramamohan Paturi和Ryan Williams领导的独立计算机科学家工作组将审查并解释该证明；应工作组要求，材料立即公开供他人检查。验证由三位专家指导，包括加州大学圣地亚哥分校的Russell Impagliazzo和Ramamohan Paturi——他们是1999年最初提出ETH团队成员——以及MIT教授Ryan Williams。工作组决定今天在GitHub发布AI输出写稿和Lean证明。

物理学信息尚未完整发布，但OpenAI称这是“一个数学严格的 existence proof（存在性证明）”，涉及四维中包含规范场和费米子的某些相互作用量子场论，包括量子色动力学（QCD）和粒子物理标准模型的统一完成。David Gross将领导包括Michael Douglas、Arthur Jaffe、Igor Klebanov和Nikita Nekrasov的小组“shepherd”这项工作。

OpenAI承认，这种让特定专家先接收输出的做法本身可能有问题。其数学顾问小组AGMAI昨天表示，“我们建议AI公司不要采用”指定某些人先获得输出的做法，理由包括获取不平等、借用声誉和选择性偏倚；建议未来AI实验室在学术存储库发布输出，并附Lean形式化证明、问题选择信息、资助理解结果的人员等。OpenAI还发布致社区公开信，就如何审查该声明和制定AI生成突破的处理规范征求意见，提出三类问题：AI生成结果的早期获取应遵循何种预期、利益冲突披露及未发表材料用于后续研究的规范；如何认可新发现与检查、修复、简化、解释和扩展工作的贡献；在方法和研究方向变化时如何支持学生和研究人员，同时保留质疑结果和发展新思想所需的理解与判断力。

原文未给出具体速度、资源消耗或基准测试数值，核心“参数”是复杂度类别和维度范围：数学覆盖所有空间维度≥2及猜想范围内全部内部区域；计算机科学覆盖固定宽度CNF的精确计数、次指数时间与多项式空间，并以3-SAT反驳ETH；物理覆盖四维规范场与费米子、QCD及标准模型统一完成。影响上，若成立，将冲击复杂性理论对ETH的信念、推动调和分析与限制猜想研究，并为量子场论严格构造提供新路径；应用场景包括SAT求解与精确计数、算法复杂度下界、波传播与限制估计、以及量子场论和标准模型基础研究。但原文强调验证和社区规范仍是关键，相关数学结果可能需多年消化。

history.content: As it prepares to go public, Anthropic’s S-1 filing makes generative AI’s methane dependency glaringly obvious.“Competition for access to electrical supply and data center locations with adequate power availability is intense.”In documents filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission Monday, Anthropic acknowledges that data centers are becoming increasingly reliant on “natural gas” — the fossil fuel industry’s marketing term for what is primarily methane — leaving the company’s AI data center buildout vulnerable to rising fuel costs and existing supply chain constraints. And in a possible catch-22, Anthropic admits that rising global temperatures — a symptom of burning fossil fuels — will increase the company’s operating costs.“Competition for access to electrical supply and data center locations with adequate power availability is intense,” Anthropic says, adding that some of its planned data centers rely on electricity generated by natural gas turbines on-site. Anthropic leases capacity from hyperscalers, but it announced a $50 billion dollar plan last year to expand data centers in Texas and New York.The US, the epicenter for data centers globally, is planning to build more fossil fuel generation capacity than it has in a decade as data centers demand more electricity. Donald Trump’s administration has sought to kill renewable energy projects while tilting the regulatory landscape in favor of fossil fuels, which Trump claims is a more important energy source for powering data centers around the clock than solar and wind farms that generate power intermittently.Now, a shortage of gas turbines is slowing data center construction. Some developers are installing gas engines on-site as a way to avoid long wait times to connect to power grids. Developers are also turning to more simple turbine technology at these sites as they face backlogs from turbine manufacturers, making on-site power generation less efficient and more polluting as a result.Data center electricity demand could wipe out decades of gains in air quality over the next five years, one recent Texas-based study found — raising levels of soot, smog-forming pollutants, and planet-heating carbon dioxide. Even as data centers create more greenhouse gas pollution, Anthropic’s S-1 points to climate change as a risk to its bottom line. It will have to pay more for electricity and water to cool servers at data centers as temperatures climb.Nevertheless, Anthropic expects increased competition for natural gas and pipeline capacity from hyperscalers and cloud service providers rushing to build their own data centers. “This competition could drive up the price of natural gas,” the company notes.RelatedData centers could erase decades of air quality gainsThe fossil fuel comeback is hereGas makes up the biggest chunk of the US electricity mix, 40 percent of the nation’s power generation. And Americans are already feeling the pain of rising costs as utilities scramble to upgrade energy infrastructure and meet rising power demand.Pissed-off residents have successfully blocked dozens of proposed data centers across the US. Anthropic acknowledges that the specter of ballooning utility bills is enough to interfere with a data center project. “If our efforts to secure electrical power are perceived to affect other utility customers and the broader grid, regulators may impose conditions, standby charges, or other requirements intended to address such impacts,” it says.If regulators push data center developers to shoulder more of the costs for new energy infrastructure, Anthropic says that could also raise its operating costs. And without a secure gas supply and the pipelines to transport the fuel, the company says, it might need to delay or abandon planned data center projects altogether.Ultimately, these challenges could stunt Anthropic’s growth:Any failure to secure access to adequate electrical power, any legal, regulatory, or other administrative action or change limiting the availability of electricity, or any significant increase in energy or compliance costs, could adversely affect our cost structure and limit our ability to scale our compute infrastructure, develop and deploy our models, and service our customers.
history.author: Justine Calma
history.titleZh: Anthropic 正燃烧天然气助推 AI 热潮
history.descriptionZh:
Anthropic在准备上市之际向美国证券交易委员会提交的S-1文件，罕见地把生成式AI扩张背后的能源约束摆到了台前：公司承认，其数据中心建设正越来越依赖“天然气”——也就是化石燃料行业对以甲烷为主要成分的气体的营销说法——这使其AI数据中心扩张容易受到燃料价格上涨和供应链瓶颈的冲击。文件还揭示了某种“进退两难”：燃烧化石燃料推高全球气温，而气温上升又会增加公司运营成本。

背景上，大模型训练和推理需要大规模GPU集群，数据中心功率密度高、用电连续且巨大，电力供应和具备足够电力的数据中心选址竞争非常激烈。Anthropic表示，部分规划中的数据中心依赖现场天然气涡轮机发电；公司从超大规模云服务商租赁算力，但去年宣布了500亿美元计划，在得克萨斯州和纽约州扩建数据中心。美国是全球数据中心建设中心，在数据中心用电需求推动下，正计划建设十年来规模最大的化石燃料发电装机容量。特朗普政府试图削减可再生能源项目，并在监管上偏向化石燃料，声称天然气比间歇性发电的太阳能和风电更适合全天候为数据中心供电。

技术路径上，由于燃气轮机短缺拖慢数据中心建设，一些开发商在现场安装燃气发动机以避开并网长时间等待；面对涡轮机制造商积压，开发商还转向更简单的涡轮技术，导致现场发电效率更低、污染更重。天然气占美国发电结构的40%，是美国最大电源。一项近期基于得克萨斯州的研究发现，数据中心电力需求可能在未来五年抹去数十年来空气质量改善成果，推高烟尘、形成雾霾的污染物和导致地球升温的二氧化碳排放。与此同时，Anthropic的S-1把气候变化列为底线风险：随着气温上升，公司需要为数据中心电力以及冷却服务器的水支付更多费用。

影响和场景上，Anthropic预计，超大规模云服务商和云服务提供商争相建设自有数据中心，将加剧对天然气和管道容量的竞争，“这种竞争可能推高天然气价格”。美国居民已感受到公用事业升级和电力需求上升带来的成本压力，愤怒的居民已成功阻止全美数十个拟建数据中心。Anthropic承认，公用事业账单膨胀的预期足以干扰数据中心项目；如果其确保电力的努力被认为影响其他公用事业客户和更广泛电网，监管机构可能施加条件、备用费或其他要求。若监管推动数据中心开发商承担更多新能源基础设施成本，也会提高其运营成本。没有可靠的天然气供应和输送管道，公司可能不得不推迟或放弃规划中的数据中心项目。最终，这些挑战可能抑制Anthropic增长：任何无法获得足够电力、限制电力供应的法律监管行动、能源或合规成本显著上升，都可能不利其成本结构，限制其扩展算力基础设施、开发和部署模型以及服务客户的能力。
